description: Calendar date to which the guest counts apply (documented as string YYYY/M/D). International: one row per nationality per date. Domestic: exactly one row per date.
Full name of the country from which the flight departs.
City of origin; some countries have several departure cities.
Destination city; 'Abu Dhabi' in all observed records.

role: derived predictor (airline count, Etihad seat share)
description: Operating airline; 'Unknown' for a few unidentified records.
Average number of flights per week on the route during the reporting month. Dictionary: 'Populated with * in most observed rows … may not be available'.
Point-to-point Business Class passengers (Abu Dhabi is their final destination). * = not available.
Business Class seats available on the route for the month. * = n/a (e.g. no Business cabin).
Point-to-point Economy Class passengers for the route.
Economy Class seats available on the route.
Point-to-point First Class passengers; predominantly * (few routes offer First).
First Class seats available; predominantly * as most airlines do not operate First.
Share of seat capacity occupied: Total PAX / Total Seats. Documented as a percentage string; values above 100% possible (overbooking / infant counting).
Point-to-point passengers across all cabins: journey originates at the departure city and terminates at Abu Dhabi.
All passengers on board across classes, including P2P and transfer/transit.
Total passengers minus lap infants; typically 1–5 below Total PAX.
Total seat capacity offered across all cabins; the Load Factor denominator.
Passengers who arrived on this route and transferred to another flight at Abu Dhabi (change of aircraft / flight number).
Passengers in transit through Abu Dhabi (same aircraft / simpler connection). Mostly 0.
Business Class passengers who transferred at Abu Dhabi. * = not available.
Economy Class passengers who transferred at Abu Dhabi. * = not available.
First Class passengers who transferred at Abu Dhabi. * = not available.
Business Class passengers in transit at Abu Dhabi. * = not available.
Economy Class passengers in transit at Abu Dhabi. * = not available.
First Class passengers in transit (note the abbreviated name vs. the 'Class Count' pattern). * = not available.
IATA code of the arrival airport; 'AUH' in all observed records.
